paragraphs: Chapter 811
Episode 202. Crisis of Drekhorn (1)
The gateway entering the Empire, the second star of Hyran.
"What is that? Something is approaching at an incredible speed. If my eyes aren't deceiving me."
"…A person? It looks like a person. But can a person run at such speed, this is insane! Open the gate, hurry!"
The soldiers guarding the gate were shocked and quickly changed their stance.
Dante was running towards them at a frenzied speed. He had sprinted ahead of the exhausted dragon knights and hatchlings who had evacuated with him.
Whoosh-!
As Dante passed through the gate, the soldiers' clothes and hair were blown about. Dante, caught in a quick glance by the soldiers, looked hideous, his skin shriveled and cracked.
It was evident how desperately he was running. The strong body, inherited from Ron's true power, was on the brink of exhaustion just from running.
"Huff Huff! Huff! Huff!"
"Your Highness!"
"Cough!"
Having entered the city in an instant, Dante finally stopped and coughed up blood while catching his breath. It wouldn't be surprising if he collapsed right now.
"My Lord! Are you alright, what happened…!"
"Im, huff, immediately, cough, contact Tikan, huff."
"What should I convey!"
"Immediately, Jin, dispatch to Dragon's Castle. Heodo is in danger. The enemy tribe, their fleet attacked! The scale is, more than a hundred ships. Even the Great Battle King Drekhorn."
"Understood!"
"And also ask the Archduke to come here! I need to go back and fight! Bring me water and elixirs!"
Tikan immediately received the communication.
"Enemy tribe attack? Heodo is in danger!? Jin Gongja is now in the Sword Garden. I'll get in touch right away. The Archduke will arrive there within about ten minutes."
{Understood, Your Highness Kasimir!}

"My muscle pig is in danger!? He's not supposed to be in such danger? King, let us know quickly. And tell the Archduke to take the Sword Emperor and also drop by the Holy Nation! The Saint King can recover from anything if he hasn't died."
[Kasimir, I will go with Sirius too. While fighting them, I might remember something from the past. Drekhorn, I remember his unique ability was quite dangerous.]
"Lady Ameris! My muscle pig will be okay, right?"
[Sandra, you tend to underestimate Heodo, or rather. He's a man that even I can't defeat with pure swordsmanship. So don't worry and wait. We'll definitely take revenge and return.]
"Then at least take Veil with you."
[I was thinking the same. For dealing with a fleet, there's hardly anyone more specialized than Veil.]
The Sword Garden also received the communication right away.
[Dragon Castle, understood. Lord So will depart within 1 minute.]
[Butler Chief, we will go too!]

[Black Sword Chairman, Law Method Chairman, Life Path Grand Instructor will also be sent. Soon, Runkandel will come to save Lord Hedo, so please tell your colleagues not to worry too much, Your Majesty.]
{Understood, Chief Butler.}
From the Empire to Tikhan, from Tikhan to the Sword Garden.
The moment when the communication device obtained from Mariette's inheritance glowed. Each base of the Barmel Union was quickly understanding the situation and sending support.
Runkandel, Lord So, three former chief lords, the Sword Emperor and Bi-kung's Little Palace Lord, and Veil and the big snake, Ameris.
Even if it was called the strongest in the world, the party headed towards Dragon Castle without a hitch.

[Khahat! It's been a long time since we've had a lively rampage. That Hedo guy should be holding out well, so you don't have to worry too much, great-grandson. Eek! There's no butler here, right? Phew, it's awkward to have to look around before calling a great-grandson a great-grandson.]
"We're leaving, ancestors. As soon as we arrive, my great-grandfather, Alpen Lord, and I will start fighting, and Tasha Lord, after landing Red Owl in the safety zone, please join us."
[Understood.]
"We are going to teach them a harsh lesson about touching the chief of staff of our Barmel Union......"
Snap!

Jin gritted his teeth and said. Since the Yemyeong clan woke up underground, today was the day when his anger peaked the most. They had no fear and directly targeted the Barmel Union, which had been targeting Kinzello and Ziffle.
As the Red Owl was enveloped in mana and took off, Runkandel's party was able to reach Dragon Castle in no time.
As soon as the space jump was over, the Red Owl temporarily lost its center due to the impact of the bombardment.

And Jin relieved his chest at the fact. Through the glass cover, he saw the sight of the red fleet spewing shells like crazy, which meant that Hedo was still alive. If it was just shelling to destroy the castle, it should have ended long ago.
"Lord Hedo!"
[Kahaha! Hedo, the Lords of Runkandel have come to save you!]

Jin, Balas, and Alpen jumped into the center of the shelling and swung their swords. The sword energy of the three people erased the huge semicircle formed by the shelling in an instant, revealing the figure of Hedo buried inside.
Hedo raised his head and called Jin with a cracked voice.

Fortunately, there were no serious external injuries, but it was clear that the internal injuries were severe. His distinctive huge muscles were so dried up and shrunk (yet still huge), and the high muscular definition reached a disgusting point.
"Are you okay!"
"Mosquito... The mosquito bastard, sucked all my blood. Fortunately, the Sword Emperor called for reinforcements in time."
Hedo said with a sorrowful look.

If he had been in a one-on-one fight with the mosquito bastard, Drek Horn, he would never have been pushed this far. No matter how unreasonable his abilities were, he would have definitely fought a fair fight. He also had the confidence that he could win.
"But when he approached, his blood was sucked away, and when he distanced himself, he was chased, and even while fighting tangled, the fleet's bombardment astonishingly hit only Hedo accurately.
The reason he was able to survive till now, facing Drak Hon's fleet alone, was because he was 'Hedo'.
Drak stepped back immediately as soon as the Red Owl appeared in the sky.
"The unique ability of that mosquito is blood sucking. Within a certain distance, you can't stop it no matter what you do. The blood just drains out of your body and gets absorbed by it."
"Understood, Sir Hedo. Step back and recover. Sir Syris will be bringing a healer soon."
"Haha! I can't remember the last time I swung my sword so freely! Come, come! Come see! It's not common to die by the sword of the King of Knights!"

Ballas showed a majesty that deflected the red fleet's bombardment like swatting arrows while swinging his single arm sword. Every time he laughed cheerfully and spat out his fighting spirit, a ridiculously huge sword wind occurred.
"Isn't it too hard from the start, 57th?"
"Heh! Our 20th is complaining again! Or have you forgotten that Ameris increased our remaining time? There's no need to save strength like when we were terminally ill, hahaha!"
"Shortest 6 months, longest 1 year. That's probably the limit of our existence."
The words Tasha said shortly after Jin became the house lord.

However, after joining the Alliance, Ameris delayed the extinction of the former house lords using an ancient spell. Therefore, the former house lords did not have to worry about fighting and hastening their extinction.
"Haha, I was worried if 57th was tired because he died of old age."
"Oh, you! It was a provocative comment."

"What, cocky!? Me!? Look here, 57th, I may be younger now but I am your ancestor. An extremely distant one. I've been considerate thinking of your age even though I am your ancestor, but this is a bit much, isn't it?"

"Heh heh, then let's bet, 20th. I can't see very well because it's too far, but roughly counting, there are just over a hundred ships. Let's see who has destroyed more ships when the battle is over. The name of the winner, the King of Knights or the Knight of Light, will be more elevated."
"Good! No room for argument."
"Then, then. The stakes should be the Eternal Flame."
While they were half joking, half serious, the two lifted Jin's mood.
'That old guy, maybe because his comrade almost died, he's fiercely serious!'
'If the butler saw him like this, he wouldn't dare speak......'
His back, full of killing intent, enough to make even the former house lords take notice, was indeed the ruler of the swordsmen.
"Once Sir Tasha joins and starts protecting Sir Hedo, I will focus solely on that mosquito, ancestors."
Meaning they should prevent other enemies or ships from intervening in the fight. The former house lords nodded their heads with a satisfied and proud heart.
Until Tasha arrived, Drak kept retreating and killing the members of the Alliance.
'Is that Jin Runcandel? He definitely feels different from the Sword Emperor or Hedo.'
Should I retreat?
Such a thought crossed Drak's mind. Shimat had repeatedly told him what happened because Lakiman did not use the return spell in time.
"But the gains were too scanty to retreat now.
Above all, it was strange for a few to be scared and retreat while he, in his heyday, was leading the Red Fleet himself. It wasn't even the horrendous Chingmyo clan god.

'I've gotten stronger by taking Hedo's blood just before it was sealed, maybe I should join them. If I can capture one of them and completely absorb it as nourishment, it's not entirely a dream to break him and become the next god.'
The fleet has moved far enough away while dealing with Hedo.

Fight first, and use the return spell when it's absolutely impossible to win. Drek made that decision. After all, more catalysts were needed than those brought in advance for all compatriots to use the return spell safely. It was also a way to shed weaker compatriots.
Tasha joined the party and raised her twin swords. Jin loosened up and looked back at his ancestors.
"The fewer people who return alive through the return spell, the better. Once Siris and the reinforcements arrive, destroy that fleet altogether. Research can be done with the wreckage."
With that, Jin rushed towards Drek like an arrow shot. The continued bombardment failed to keep up with Jin's increased speed.
In a flash, Jin located Drek and fired a lightspeed stab with Sigmund. The flat terrain meant there was nowhere to hide if the bombardment was erased.
Zweong-!
Sigmund tore through the shield and struck Drek's forehead. Drek blocked the attack with his spear and smiled.
Jin had come into the blood-sucking distance himself.
"Jin Lunkandel, I didn't expect to meet you like this today. I'm Drek Horn, the Great Warrior of the Jeokmyeong Clan."
"Now is the time to make a will, not to introduce yourself."
"That's great confidence, but you'd better not compare me to Rakiman."
Jin did not answer and continued to attack. First, he intended to gauge the degree of risk of the blood-sucking ability Hedo had mentioned and then adjust the flow of the battle.
Drek defended unilaterally against Jin. Just taking enough hits would bring blood in.
But shortly afterwards, both Jin and Drek had questions.
'Is he hiding his blood-sucking ability? I don't feel the blood draining at all. It's not visible either.'
'...why isn't blood draining from him!?'
Soon Jin read Drek's barely suppressed baffled feelings and came to this conclusion.
'Oh, the unique ability of this mosquito. Could it have been a kind of curse?'
Drek's face quickly lost its composure, and Jin smirked.
"Why, is something not working? Mosquito, it's time to pay the price."
As Jin said that.
From the rear of the battlefield came Mot's cheerful cry. Boing, boing!
The members of the Union, who had set out through the Empire and the Holy Kingdom from Tichan, had just arrived at the battlefield.
